title: Los Altos History Museum

services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: Nestled amidst majestic heritage oaks and one of the last few remaining apricot orchards of Santa Clara Valley, the grounds and facilities of the Los Altos History Museum provide a captivating backdrop to share life’s most significant events and create its most cherished memories. Whether saying your wedding vows under the stately redwood pergola or dancing the night away with a view of the Museum’s lush moonlit gardens, you and your guests will never forget the experience as you create your own history in a setting of true natural beauty and relaxed sophistication. The Museum is available for wedding rentals* on Fridays, Saturdays & Sundays, and other special event rentals during the week.
